meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ниматься'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'film, appear in a video'.

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и сниматься вовремя.
examples.trans: We need to do everything and film on time.

examples.text: На нашей кухне все умеют сниматься.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'here, there', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.trans: Hello, Arkady Borisovich!

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'хожий'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('look like, similar').

examples.trans: You look like Iosif Prigozhin.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'здравлять'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'congratulations', paired with 'поздравить'.

examples.trans: Well done, he looks like him! Congratulations.
Great, congratulations!
Happy holiday to you!

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'мысл'). Common masculine noun meaning 'sense, meaning' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: What do you mean?

meanings.en: to guess, to work out, to think of
meanings.note: Prefix 'до-' marks reaching a boundary or finishing the remainder of an action (stem 'гадаться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'guessed, thought of', paired with 'догадываться'.

examples.trans: Why didn't I think of it at once!

examples.text: Какой глупый человек догадался это сделать?
examples.trans: What foolish person thought of doing that?

examples.text: Ты никогда сам не догадаешься об этом.
examples.trans: You will never guess this by yourself.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to shave'.

examples.trans: And did you not think to shave the moustache?

examples.text: А что вы делаете? Руки бреете?
examples.trans: And what are you doing? Shaving your arms?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'then', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.trans: From this moment I stop lying.

examples.text: Мне очень стыдно за этого придурка.

examples.text: Этого вообще никто не видел. Правда, Макс?
examples.trans: Nobody saw a thing at all. Right, Max?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'would', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.trans: Be glad. How was the injury sustained?

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'овсем').

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'пектакль'). Common masculine noun meaning 'performance, charade' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: Your performance has dragged on.

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'тянуться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'dragged on'.

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и затянуться вовремя.

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.trans: I really am Iosif Prigozhin!

examples.text: Настроение у меня действительно очень хорошее.
examples.trans: My mood really is very good.
This is indeed an important question.

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'ождать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'wait', paired with 'ждать'.

examples.trans: Wait, I'll be right there.

examples.text: Подожди, Нин, ты не поняла. Это же стыдно!
examples.trans: Wait, Nina, you don't get it. It's shameful!

meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'пустить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'will let go', paired with 'отпускать'.

examples.trans: Release him immediately!
Let me go home.
What bribe? Release him immediately!

examples.text: Вика, подожди! Не отпущу, пока не поверишь.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'верить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'will believe', paired with 'верить'.

examples.text: То есть Пригожину ты поверишь, а мне нет?

examples.text: Вика, подожди! Не отпущу, пока не поверишь.
